verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only fragments of the story. A community comment credits Column with per-account-number ACH permissions and limits. Book transfers support a `hold: true` state, and overdraft allowance can be enabled per account. Nothing documents velocity limits, program-level risk policies, automated holds on suspicious activity, or account freezes with reinstatement paths. Missing for 10: first-party docs on transaction/velocity limits, per-program risk controls, suspicious-activity holds, account freeze and documented reinstatement workflow.
